page.overview:
Who is Bandor?

Bandor was a Moff who represented the planet of Questal. Bandor championed the Hurlothrumbic Generator project: a device which could stimulate the brain into feeling fear.

With his blue eyes and close-cropped black hair, Bandor was considered attractive by Human standards, although a little gruff. Measuring 1.90 meters, he also had a weightlifter physique.
